$Comment: How much faster a player earns favor on Santa's Nice List (the reputation Christmas_Nice_List) while wearing or eating something that raises it, in whole percent points (10 is +10%): each piece of the Christmas Set (Armor.StatModifiers on the Christmas Hat, Coat, Gloves and Trousers), the set's four-piece tier (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Set.json) and the Christmas Cake's effect, each Additive on the Max. ziggfreed-common adds it to the global ReputationGain and multiplies every gain on the Nice List (a Present Thief, a quest, Santa's daily word) by 1 + the total, and past Santa's Favorite too, where each multiple of Beyond's Every pays a Santa's Sack. A loss of favor is never changed, and favor already earned never moves when the gear comes off. The id is ReputationGain_ and the reputation's group id, which is how the library finds it. Base Max 0, so a player wearing none of it earns the amount written; Min -100 keeps a subtractive modifier from ever turning a gain into nothing. Its tooltip line is the client.lang key itemTooltip.stats.ReputationGain_Christmas_Nice_List.
